editorial.copyrightPolicy: Publisher article text, reviews, lyrics and translations are never copied or reproduced; facts are stated in Swoon'd's own words with links to the original source.

masteryModel.usefulCompetenceStatement: She can follow a conversation about a comeback, a show week or a concert plan, use the roles and fan words kindly, understand what a win or a chart does and does not say, ask a couple of genuinely curious questions about her favourite group, and handle a hard story with care, without faking any of it.

licensingConstraints.constraint: Only original synthesised or commissioned audio (licence original-swoond), including commissioned native-speaker word recordings; no commercial recordings, no snippets of hits, no clones of a specific work. Real songs reached only through the official platform (spec sections 20 and 40).
Lyrics and lyric translations are never reproduced or ingested, including short quotes; example lines are invented.
Original illustrations only (license original-swoond); no member photos, concept photos, album art or real lightstick designs; generic objects only.
Agency, group, lightstick, awards and platform marks: text mentions only; no logo files.
No embedded music videos, dance practices, fancams or variety clips; deep-link to official channels.
Never copy publisher or press text; headlines with links only.

Spotify, Apple Music, Ticketmaster, Bandsintown, Billboard/Luminate, Melon, Hanteo and Circle Chart each have terms; every provider sits behind a Swoon'd adapter; no scraping; fan platforms without public APIs are not scraped.
Member and group names as dated facts only; no likeness, fabricated quotes or implied endorsement.
Korean terms use Revised Romanization with common fan spellings noted; reviewed by a Korean-language reviewer before release.

safetyConstraints: Wellbeing and controversy content follows safe-messaging guidance: no methods, no speculation about real people, no rumours, no diagnosis; point to local crisis resources by region.
Privacy: never coach locating private addresses, following idols or approaching them off-stage; sasaeng behaviour is named as harmful.
Parasocial feelings are treated as normal and human; teach healthy boundaries without shaming.
Money: albums, merch and paid messages are not gamified; teach budgeting, official channels and scam awareness (photocard trading, resale).
Crowds and hearing: note exits, water and meeting points; hearing protection; general information, not medical advice.
Fandom conflict: never encourage pile-ons, doxxing or brigading.
Never encourage the learner to fake expertise or taste, rank members or grade her taste.
A cultural review by Korean and Korean-diaspora fan reviewers is required before release.
